en.title: Invincible VS Devs Open to Mortal Kombat Crossover, Scorpion Eyed
en.summary: The developers behind the upcoming 3v3 fighter **Invincible VS** are enthusiastic about the possibility of a crossover with the brutal **Mortal Kombat** franchise. Lead designers have expressed a desire for guest characters who can fit the violent tone of their universe.
en.body:
The vibrant, violent universe of **Invincible** might soon collide with another realm of ultimate fighting. Developers at the studio behind the highly anticipated **Invincible VS** have revealed their openness to incorporating guest characters from other IPs, with the **Mortal Kombat** franchise topping their wish list.

During a recent sit-down at Evo 2026, **Invincible VS** Game Director Dave Hall and Lead Combat Designer Bau Bautista discussed the potential for crossovers. While emphasizing that any guest character must reasonably fit within the established tone of the **Invincible** universe – ruling out characters like Mario due to their inherent lack of brutality – they enthusiastically welcomed the idea of characters from more mature, action-packed franchises. Bautista specifically mentioned Scorpion as a desirable inclusion, stating, "If there's an opportunity, I'm not going to say no to Scorpion."

> "I think for us, the Invincible universe is just such a beautiful, violent universe that they would have to fit that. I wouldn't want to put Mario or Luigi in there. That'd be cool, don't get me wrong, but I don't want to rip his head off." — Dave Hall

This sentiment is particularly resonant given the history of crossovers within **Invincible** comics. "One of the things to keep in mind is, Invincible has a ton of guests and crossovers throughout the comics, so it's not outside the realm of possibility," Bautista added. The developers also lauded NetherRealm Studios, the creators of **Mortal Kombat**, calling them "the best."

## A Community Dream Matchup

The prospect of seeing characters from **Mortal Kombat** duking it out with the superpowered cast of **Invincible** is sure to excite fans of both franchises. Fighting games have seen a surge in guest character inclusions, with recent examples like **Tekken 8** adding Yujiro Hanma and **Street Fighter 6** featuring Tifa Lockhart. **Invincible VS** aims to deliver a competitive 3v3 tag team experience with advanced netcode, a different approach from **Mortal Kombat 1**'s 1v1 mechanics. However, the shared DNA of brutal combat and a willingness to explore unique character integrations makes this potential crossover a perfect storm for fighting game enthusiasts.

## What's Next

**Invincible VS** is slated for a 2026 release, with more fighter reveals and events planned leading up to launch. Fans eager to see how this potential **Mortal Kombat** collaboration might unfold will be keeping a close eye on future announcements from the development team.

es.body:
El vibrante y violento universo de Invincible podría chocar pronto con otro reino de lucha extrema. Los desarrolladores del estudio detrás del muy esperado Invincible VS han revelado su apertura a incorporar personajes invitados de otras franquicias, con Mortal Kombat en lo más alto de su lista de deseos.

Durante una reciente reunión en Evo 2026, el director de juego de Invincible VS, Dave Hall, y el diseñador de combate principal, Bau Bautista, discutieron la posibilidad de crossovers. Mientras enfatizaban que cualquier personaje invitado debe encajar razonablemente dentro del tono establecido del universo de Invincible – descartando personajes como Mario debido a su falta inherente de brutalidad – recibieron con entusiasmo la idea de personajes de franquicias más maduras y de acción. Bautista mencionó específicamente a Scorpion como una inclusión deseable, diciendo: > "Si hay una oportunidad, no voy a decir que no a Scorpion".

Este sentimiento es particularmente resonante dado el historial de crossovers dentro de los cómics de Invincible. "Una de las cosas que hay que tener en cuenta es que Invincible tiene una tonelada de invitados y crossovers a lo largo de los cómics, así que no está fuera del ámbito de lo posible", agregó Bautista. Los desarrolladores también elogiaron a NetherRealm Studios, los creadores de Mortal Kombat, llamándolos "los mejores".

## Un Sueño de la Comunidad

La perspectiva de ver a personajes de Mortal Kombat luchando contra el elenco superpoderoso de Invincible es emocionante para los fanáticos de ambas franquicias. Los juegos de lucha han visto un aumento en la inclusión de personajes invitados, con ejemplos recientes como Tekken 8 agregando a Yujiro Hanma y Street Fighter 6 presentando a Tifa Lockhart. Invincible VS apunta a ofrecer una experiencia competitiva de equipo de 3v3 con avanzado netcode, un enfoque diferente a la mecánica 1v1 de Mortal Kombat 1. Sin embargo, el ADN compartido de combate brutal y la voluntad de explorar integraciones únicas de personajes hace que este crossover potencial sea una tormenta perfecta para los entusiastas de los juegos de lucha.

## Próximos Pasos

Invincible VS está programado para su lanzamiento en 2026, con más revelaciones de personajes y eventos planeados antes del lanzamiento. Los fanáticos ansiosos por ver cómo podría desarrollarse esta posible colaboración con Mortal Kombat estarán atentos a los anuncios futuros del equipo de desarrollo.

content_raw: The minds behind Invincible VS are open to collaborations with other genres and IPs, specifically in regards to welcoming potential guest characters from the Mortal Kombat franchise. We got the chance to sit down with Invincible VS’s Game Director, Dave Hall, and its Lead Combat Designer, Bau Bautista, at Evo 2026, where we asked them about the possibility of adding guest characters from completely different properties a la Street Fighter 6 and Tekken 8 . Both Hall and Bautista enthusiastically welcomed the idea, but made sure to preface that the characters would have to reasonably fit within Invincible's world for such a crossover to make sense. “I think for us, the Invincible universe is just such a beautiful, violent universe that they would have to fit that. I wouldn't want to put Mario or Luigi in there. That'd be cool, don't get me wrong, but I don't want to rip his head off,” Hall laughed. This, of course, prompted us to suggest characters from the equally bloody Mortal Kombat universe, which received eager nods of approval from both developers. “NetherRealm, they’re the best. That would be incredible,” Hall said. “If there's an opportunity, I'm not going to say no to Scorpion, " Bautista added. "One of the things to keep in mind is, Invincible has a ton of guests and crossovers throughout the comics, so it's not outside the realm of possibility. If we have that opportunity, yes, I'm going to take that.” If there's an opportunity, I'm not going to say no to Scorpion. Guest characters are a hot topic within the fighting game community as of late, with Tekken 8 revealing Yujiro Hanma for Season Three and Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves adding Kenshiro to the fray this summer — not to mention Final Fantasy VII’s Tifa Lockhart making her way into Street Fighter 6 in early 2027. Mortal Kombat itself is a franchise famous for bringing in wild guest characters from other media genres, including the Xenomorph from Alien, The Boys' Homelander , and even Omni-Man himself. It’s a trend that’s sweeping across the entire fighting game landscape right now, and one that the Invincible VS team is clearly open to joining if the stars align. And with the groundwork already laid in Mortal Kombat 1 , it's not a stretch to assume this crossover might come to fruition on Skybound's side. More specifically, Hall and Bautista mentioned Immortal’s 'revive' technique in keeping with his canonical status as, well, The Immortal.
